review_candidates.title: Web Dev Project Manager
review_candidates.description_excerpt: You will be responsible for coordinating projects across different teams, monitoring progress, identifying potential delays and ensuring projects are completed accurately and on time. Assign and monitor tasks and ensure team members understand their responsibilities and deadlines. Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information within our project management systems. Develop and maintain project documentation, SOPs and reporting where required. Ensure completed work meets project requirement
eligibility_evidence: Experience managing remote or internationally distributed teams.
We observe local public holidays, allowing team members to rest and celebrate their national holidays.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Ensure completed work meets project requirements before projects are considered complete. Project management qualifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or Scrum certification .
